name.Description: Generated name <NWB electrode group>_<NWB electrode id, zero-padded>. The source does not store the clinical contact labels; the number is the NWB electrodes-table id, not a clinical contact number.

type.Description: ECOG unless the source group description states a depth electrode (then SEEG).

low_cutoff.Description: Lower edge of the authors' 1-200 Hz band-pass.

high_cutoff.Description: Upper edge of the authors' 1-200 Hz band-pass.

standard_deviation.Description: Source column: SD of the electrode over the whole file (authors).

kurtosis.Description: Source column: kurtosis of the electrode over the whole file (authors).

low_freq_R2.Description: Source column: R^2 for low-frequency band (authors' decoding model).

high_freq_R2.Description: Source column: R^2 for high-frequency band (authors' decoding model).
